create_solvent_from_atoms: create a Solvent object by passing an ase.Atoms object representing a solvent molecule
create_solvent_from_db: create a Solvent object by passing a solvent_id_from_db index to load from the solvent database
get_molecules_per_volume: get the number of molecules per angstrom cubed using the molecules_per_volume property
get_solvent_molar_mass: get the molar mass of a solvent by accessing the molar_mass attribute after initialization
load_solvent_with_custom_density: load a solvent from the database with a custom density by passing solvent_density to the constructor
